strings.name: Ted Pick
strings.role: Chairman and CEO of Morgan Stanley
strings.summary: Ted Pick joined Morgan Stanley in 1990 and moved from equity capital markets, sales and trading, and institutional securities into group leadership. He became CEO in 2024 and chairman in 2025, leading a financial services firm spanning institutional securities, wealth management and investment management.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Appointment announcements and effective dates, and the separate CEO and chairman transitions, are distinguished. Market and AI assessments in interviews are opinions, not realized outcomes.
strings.influence.rationale: Helped revive Morgan Stanley's institutional securities business and took responsibility for group leadership and strategic integration.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Graduated from Middlebury College in 1990 and received an MBA from Harvard Business School in 1994.
strings.facts.f2.label: Governance and philanthropy
strings.facts.f2.value: Trustee of the Metropolitan Museum of Art and chair of the advisory board of the Morgan Stanley Alliance for Children's Mental Health.
strings.highlights.h1.title: From markets to group leadership
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led global sales and trading, institutional securities and corporate strategy before becoming CEO and chairman.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Capital markets perspectives
strings.highlights.h2.text: Discussed AI investment, IPO financing and market changes in 2026 interviews; these assessments should be understood as his views.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Bloomberg interview episode published
strings.timeline.t1.text: The episode description records an interview at a Hong Kong summit about AI capital expenditure and markets; this is the publication date.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Adds chairmanship
strings.timeline.t2.text: Succeeded James Gorman as chairman after one year as CEO; the appointment was announced in October 2024.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Becomes CEO and joins board
strings.timeline.t3.text: Succeeded James Gorman as CEO; the October 25, 2023 announcement is distinct from the effective date.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Becomes co-president
strings.timeline.t4.text: Also became co-head of corporate strategy while continuing to lead institutional securities at that time.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Leads institutional securities
strings.timeline.t5.text: Became head of institutional securities, covering investment banking, equities, fixed income and other areas.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Leads global sales and trading
strings.timeline.t6.text: Moved from equities leadership to global head of sales and trading.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Earns Harvard MBA
strings.timeline.t7.text: Completed a Master of Business Administration at Harvard Business School.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Graduates and joins Morgan Stanley
strings.timeline.t8.text: Graduated from Middlebury College and joined Morgan Stanley the same year.
